page.content:
New Kingdom spells for leaving the tomb and passing the Duat.

How Book of the Dead connects

  • Event: Weighing of the heart — The Book of the Dead illustrates the weighing of the heart.
  • Location: Duat — The Book of the Dead maps spells for passing the Duat.

What is Book of the Dead?

The Book of the Dead is a modern name for the 'Book of Coming Forth by Day': illustrated papyri of spells, maps, and the weighing of the heart placed with the elite dead.

Key threads lead to Weighing of the heart and Duat.
